newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Hyundai, Samsung in petrochem tie-up.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Hyundai, Samsung in petrochem tie-up.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Petrochemical Co and Samsung General Chemicals Co have agreed in principle to build five pipelines between the two firms' petrochemical plants to supply each other, a Hyundai spokesman said on Tuesday.
"We have agreed in principle but final agreement is yet to be made," he said.
The pipelines would cost the companies a combined five billion won, he said.
The two companies' plants are located next to each other.

The spokesman said this would be the first strategic alliance among local petrochemical firms. Hyundai Petrochemical is an affiliate of Hyundai Group and Samsung General Chemicals is an affiliate of Samsung Group.
